(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Shiba Tatsuya is a First Year Student in Course 2 of the First High School. He is the eldest son of Four Leaves Technology (FLT) company's president. His only sibling is [Shiba Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki). Since he was born in April and Miyuki born in March, they are studying in the same year according to Japanese school system. He is known as a Weed, which is the considered the lower class.

He has a rather cold personality and he doesn't show his feelings, but he seems to love his sister and cares for her. He calms her down, when she's about to lose control over her magic and doesn't seem to mind that she is one of the most talented students at the school, while he's only a reserve.

He is not easily intimidated by his opponents.

__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ A-rank Magician

Miyuki is a first year student in Course 1 of First High School. She is the younger sister of [Tatsuya Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya). She is a bloom, which is considered the upper class. She was appointed as the freshmen representative, and is well known throughout the school.  Described as very beautiful, she draws attention everywhere she goes. Yet, she is still modest and kind. 

She has a warm and loving nature, and defends her brother readily. She feels bad about being labelled as a "genius"; she feels that her brother is the real genius. Miyuki feels sad that their father only cares about her, and ignores Tatsuya completely.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Mayumi is the Student Council President of First High School. She is a member of the Saegusa family, one of the 'Ten Master Clans'.

She is the very first person from First High School to converse with [Tatsuya Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya) on his enrollment day.

A First year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/), [Mikihiko](https://anilist.co/character/88201/), [Leo](https://anilist.co/character/88195/), and [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/88197/). A beauty in her own right she is someone who garners attention from those around her.

She has an outgoing personality that allows her to befriend people easily but is someone who is not easily committed and goes off on a whim, (She doesn't get along with Leo though).

A member of one of the 'Hundreds Families' the Chiba family, a family famous for training people in swordsmanship. She herself is proficient in the sword, enough for her to be recognized and allowed to carry the Chiba family name.

node.description:
Angelina Kudou Shields is a foreign exchange student from USNA who arrived at First High School during the latter half of the main characters' freshman year, taking Shizuku's place who went to study in Berkeley, California.

She is introduced as a member of the Kudou Family from the Ten Master Clans. Because of her popularity and not wanting to spend time after school, she is unable to decide which club she will join and is instead placed as a temporary member of the Student Council. She refers to herself as "Lina", and usually hangs out with Miyuki.

~!A strategic class magician of the USNA, one of the Thirteen Apostles under the alias "Angie Sirius"!~

~!Later on, gets adopted by Aoba Toudou and becomes a naturalized Japanese citizen (after retiring from the USNA army as Sirius). Currently resides with Tatsuya and Miyuki as her bodyguard.!~
A first year 1st course student in A class with [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki), Jun and [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/88191/Mitsui-Honoka).

A first year 1st course student in A class with [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki), Jun, and [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/88188/Kitayama-Shizuku).

Becomes the next student council secretary after [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/72563/Nakajou-Azusa).

A first year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), [Leo](https://anilist.co/character/88195/Saijou-Leonhart) and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika).
A member of the Kuroba Family, a branch family of the Yotsuba Clan. She is also a second cousin to the Shiba siblings.

A first year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki) and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika). He is childhood friends with Erika.

A First year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/88197/Shibata-Mizuki) and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika).

Sakurai Minami is a student of First High School. She is a member of the Second Generation Sakura Series constructed by a laboratory linked to the Yotsuba Clan. She serves as Guardian of Shiba Miyuki.

~!She is the daughter of the woman who shares the same genes as Sakurai Honami. With that, she belongs to the Sakura Series and will serve as a Guardian for the Yotsuba. Both of her parents were Augmented and are now deceased. After they died, she moved into the Yotsuba main house where she served as a maid. She was trained to be a Guardian and a servant/maid, different from Tatsuya who, except for some basic manners, was only trained to be a combat magician. Minami is Shiba Miyuki's other Guardian, therefore she attends First High School as a First Year Course 1 student in order to fulfill her Guardian duties at all times. She was assigned to this post by Yotsuba Maya as an additional layer of protection against some possible moments in the future where havoc and destruction would occur.!~

Older of the Saegusa twins and [Mayumi](https://anilist.co/character/88194/Mayumi-Saegusa)'s younger sister. She is a tomboy and could be considered a polar opposite in terms of personality when compared to her twin, Izumi. She was initially suspicious of [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Tatsuya-Shiba) but has grown to respect him.

Youngest of the Saegusa twins and [Mayumi](https://anilist.co/character/88194/Mayumi-Saegusa)'s younger sister. She is a more feminine girl when contrasted with her twin sister, Kasumi. Admires and respects both of the Shiba siblings while having a rivalry with [Ayako](https://anilist.co/character/200612/Ayako-Kuroba).
A member of the Kuroba Family, a branch family of the Yotsuba and a candidate to become Maya's successor. He has an older twin sister called Ayako.
He is a member of the Kudou Family, one of the Ten Master Clans. He attends Second High School as a second-year student.

Ancient magic user from the Great Asian Union. Looks very young despite being much older in reality. 

~!He has no loyalty to the Great Asian Union and is actively sabotaging them for his own needs. His true loyalty lies with Gu Jie.!~

Heir of the Shippou family and harbors animosity towards members of the Saegusa family, especially the twins that are in the same class as himself. Acts very impulsively and often misunderstands the status quo in many situations.

Head of the Kudou Family and one of the most prominent figures in the Ten Master Clans. Was a mentor to Kouichi, [Maya](https://anilist.co/character/213001/Maya-Yotsuba) and [Miya](https://anilist.co/character/73183/Miya-Shiba) in the past.

~!He was killed by [Minoru](https://anilist.co/character/204898/Minoru-Kudou) in volume 26 but his death was covered up as a death by illness.!~
